tickets.title: Register an approved product iteration and verify its repository
tickets.desired_behavior: An operator registers an explicitly approved idea and exact origin, then inspects durable, read-back-verified repository identity without starting work or creating an unrelated target.
acceptance_criteria: Register/onboard/inspect survive a fresh controller process and preserve exact approval, origin and immutable repository identity.
Only one iteration is active; absent/colliding targets and uncertain creation outcomes fail closed without replacement or duplicate creation.

tickets.title: Turn the resolved same-origin interview into a pinned finite milestone
tickets.desired_behavior: The conversational agent follows grill-me/grilling and to-spec, retaining actual operator decisions, whole-product vision and separate current-milestone prose in immutable repository documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Unanswered product/technical/test choices remain pending in the exact origin; no silence-based approval is admitted.
Actual selected instruction loads and skill-guided synthesis are retained; exact immutable docs and specification issue read back without editing the parent.

tickets.title: Publish milestone slices and reserve one authoritative eligible ticket
tickets.desired_behavior: The completed pinned handoff runs selected to-tickets; the operator inspects GitHub-authoritative dependency eligibility and can reserve exactly one current ticket without dispatching workers.
acceptance_criteria: Current-only vertical contracts and cycle-free blockers publish blockers first with native links, configured label and exact issue/linked-board/schema/scope/progress readbacks.

Durable intents reconcile lost publication responses without duplicates; blocked/deferred/out-of-iteration work is refused, independent eligible work remains visible, and no routine batch quiz is required.

tickets.title: Pause and restart a reserved iteration without losing its safety state
tickets.desired_behavior: The operator pauses a reserved iteration and restarts the controller; work remains checkpointed and no new admission or merge occurs until explicit safe reconciliation/resume.
acceptance_criteria: Pause survives process restart, preserves artifacts and blocks admission and ordinary merge; emergency stop retains recoverable evidence.
Resume observes exact GitHub/git/execution state first and recognizes already completed external actions without duplicate effects.

tickets.title: Admit a fresh isolated role worker only within authorized capacity
tickets.desired_behavior: A reserved assignment starts a fresh role process in a tested container with only its workspace, scratch and approved model capability; unauthorized filesystem, credential and spending operations are refused.
acceptance_criteria: Real worker/container tests deny host credentials, Docker socket and deployment secrets; reviewer source is read-only and helper contexts cannot become uncontrolled writers.
Exact role skills/dependencies/inputs are pinned and actually loaded; exhausted allowance or unapproved charge blocks admission without a paid fallback.

tickets.title: Implement, simplify and independently review one pinned assignment
tickets.desired_behavior: A fresh implement worker exercises meaningful agreed-seam tests, a separate simplifier follows simplify-code, and fresh read-only Standards/Spec reviewers independently evaluate the exact candidate.
acceptance_criteria: Actual implement/simplify-code/code-review instruction-load and execution results correlate to the pinned requirements and candidate; no hidden nested review substitutes for the independent axes.
Rejection or omitted requirements return the candidate for correction; stale verdicts, weakened checks and branch-only passing tests never imply delivery.

tickets.title: Deliver a reviewed candidate through controlled merge and integrated observation
tickets.desired_behavior: The controller autonomously merges only the exact independently reviewed and checked candidate, observes integrated main CI/CD/deployment, and closes work only after delivery verification.
acceptance_criteria: Wrong repository/branch, stale head/review, failed/missing required checks or unsafe pause/freeze state deny the controlled mutation.
Exact merge commit, main checks, deployment and issue/board state read back; an unmerged branch remains undelivered regardless of green tests.

tickets.title: Investigate stuck work while independent current tickets remain eligible
tickets.desired_behavior: Agent-declared stuckness invokes a fresh read-only diagnosing-bugs investigation; the report and real operator direction gate affected work while independent eligible work can continue.
acceptance_criteria: Actual reproduction, hypotheses and tool observations accompany the selected-skill diagnostic report; silence is never a decision.
Bugs use the common ticket contract and duplicate checks; current blockers enter this iteration, unrelated bugs stay deferred, and blocked dependents cannot be reserved.

tickets.title: Restore unhealthy main through gated roll-forward or safe revert
tickets.desired_behavior: An observed main incident freezes ordinary delivery, prioritizes a fresh diagnosing-bugs/implement repair, and resumes ordinary work only after healthy integrated evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A real unhealthy CI/CD/deployment observation freezes ordinary merge but permits correctly scoped repair through unchanged tests, simplification and independent review gates.
Roll-forward or revert reads back exact integrated health; reverted delivered behavior reopens its work item, and genuinely stuck repair waits for operator direction.

tickets.title: Pause affected work and resynthesize after an agreed material revision
tickets.desired_behavior: A material product/requirement change pauses affected assignments, versions the agreed milestone and tickets, and invalidates obsolete claims/reviews before safe resumption.
acceptance_criteria: A changed requirement cannot be merged under old assignment or verdict pins.
Actual agreed revised specs and selected to-tickets resynthesis are retained; unaffected delivered work is preserved and no future milestone is invented.

tickets.title: Deliver durable attention requests to the exact originating thread
tickets.desired_behavior: Needed decisions and incidents reach the registered origin with persisted intent and retry/deduplication; routine successful transitions remain silent and message delivery is not approval.
acceptance_criteria: A transient delivery failure retains the exact destination and recoverable intent; restart retries without discarding attention or promising exactly-once network delivery.
Only explicit actual operator input resolves a pending direction/spending boundary; normal stage successes do not create chat noise.

tickets.title: Verify a complete private validation iteration and invite the next interview
tickets.desired_behavior: The operator receives an evidence-backed outcome for the finite delivered milestone, including deferred defects and delivery health, then the factory waits for input about the next iteration of the same product.
acceptance_criteria: The public lifecycle demonstrates actual skill-guided planning/ticket/engineering stages, delivered main and agreed rejection, stuckness, recovery, pause and spending cases in the authorized private validation repository.
The completion report cites integrated evidence and unresolved/deferred bugs; no next feature batch or unrelated product starts without operator input.
